svg.text: Model-agnostic edge · Anthropic-optimized · every tool call independently re-authorized
Anthropic — native Messages API · optimized path
sandboxed · only the enforcer may call
ENFORCEMENT SEQUENCE · applied on every single call
RBAC + JSON-Schema are the authoritative controls; the model and the 112-rule semantic firewall are defense-in-depth — never trusted to be correct.
A zero-trust NetworkPolicy makes every service reachable only by its legitimate caller. Audit encrypted with AES-256-GCM. Deployed on Docker Compose / Kubernetes.
